perspective:
From Ethan Mohamud’s perspective, he knows/experienced:

- He and Gary Guo are long-time friends from middle school. Gary is a doctor, and they have stayed close, often supporting each other.
- Ethan noticed Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. Ethan became concerned about Gary’s health.
- Ethan invited Gary to a weekend retreat for relaxation and rejuvenation. He told Gary his health mattered and that a two-day break might give him a new perspective.
- Ethan heard Gary say he appreciated the concern but could not go because there was too much to do at the hospital.
- At the retreat, Ethan observed Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. Ethan suspected there was more going on than just professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, telling him they had been friends since middle school, that Gary could tell him anything, and that he was there to help, not judge.
- Ethan heard Gary say it was complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
- Gary later opened up to Ethan about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he was facing.
- Ethan offered to help Gary prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities. Gary agreed, saying he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary about his progress and challenges. Ethan saw Gary making efforts to change and felt hopeful and proud.
- Ethan told Gary he was proud of his progress and reminded him he was there whenever Gary needed to talk.
- Ethan heard Gary say things were better, he was not as overwhelmed, and he had had time for a movie the previous weekend.
- After about a year, Ethan observed Gary managing better on his own and felt satisfied and happy for him. Ethan decided to step back while letting Gary know he was always just a call away if needed.
- Ethan heard Gary thank him, say he could not have done it without Ethan’s support, and that he felt more in control now.
